name: cpr_b3_payload
description: Fluxo completo CPR/B3: lê cessoes_pendentes, join com bronze_remessa + silver_dados_auxiliares (explode informacoes_adicionais), monta struct 'payload' com instrument completo (collaterals/products/issuers/productionPlaces via window collect_list, scr/creditor/deposit structs, paymentMethod condicional para tipo_codigo_cpr='F'). 4 outputs.

transformations.name: payment_method
transformations.expression: struct(codigo_metodo_pagamento_cpr as paymentMethodCode, codigo_index_cpr as indexCode, taxa_contrato as interestRateSpreadPercentage, codigo_tipo_taxa_juros_cpr as interestRateCriteriaTypeCode)

columns.name: product_struct
columns.expression: struct(dados_auxiliares.nome_produto as cprProductName, dados_auxiliares.classe_produto as cprProductClassName, dados_auxiliares.safra_produto as cprProductHarvest, dados_auxiliares.descricao_produto as cprProductDescription, cast(dados_auxiliares.quantidade_produto as string) as cprProductQuantity, dados_auxiliares.unidade_medida as measureUnitName, dados_auxiliares.tipo_armazenamento as packagingWayName, dados_auxiliares.status_produto as cprProductStatusCode, dados_auxiliares.tipo_producao as productionTypeCode)

columns.name: issuer_struct
columns.expression: struct(nome_sacado as cprIssuerName, documento_sacado as documentNumber, CASE WHEN tipo_pessoa_sacado = '0' THEN 'PJ' WHEN tipo_pessoa_sacado = '1' THEN 'PF' ELSE 'PF' END as personTypeAcronym, dados_auxiliares.uf_emissor as stateAcronym, upper(municipio_sacado) as cityName, lpad(dados_auxiliares.natureza_juridica_emissor, 2, '0') as issuerLegalNatureCode)

columns.name: production_place_struct
columns.expression: struct(dados_auxiliares.local_producao as productionPlaceName, cast(dados_auxiliares.cep_local_producao as string) as zipCode)

columns.name: scr
columns.expression: struct(dados_auxiliares.ativo_informado_scr as scrTypeCode, numero_contrato as contractCode, dados_auxiliares.codigo_finalidade as finalityCode)

columns.name: creditor
columns.expression: struct(nome_originador as creditorName, cnpj_originador as documentNumber)

columns.name: deposit
columns.expression: struct(codigo_conta_favorecida_otc as otcFavoredAccountCode, coalesce(numero_documento_cpr, '') as documentNumber, coalesce(tipo_pessoa_sigla_cpr, '') as personTypeAcronym, numero_contrato as selfNumber, tipo_modalidade_liquidacao as settlementModalityTypeCode, total_parcelas_contrato as depositQuantity)

transformations.name: instrument_base
transformations.expression: struct(tipo_codigo_cpr as cprTypeCode, codigo_registro_conta_otc as otcRegisterAccountCode, codigo_conta_custodiante_otc as otcCustodianAccountCode, CASE WHEN indicador_emissao_eletronica = TRUE THEN 'S' WHEN indicador_emissao_eletronica = FALSE THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END as electronicEmissionIndicator, data_emissao_contrato as issueDate, data_vencimento_parcela as maturityDate, cast(dados_auxiliares.quantidade_parcela_contratada as string) as issueQuantity, cast(dados_auxiliares.valor_face_parcela as string) as issueValue, cast(dados_auxiliares.valor_face_contrato as string) as issueFinancialValue, data_referencia as profitabilityStartDate, CASE WHEN indicador_expiracao = TRUE THEN 'S' WHEN indicador_expiracao = FALSE THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END as automaticExpirationIndicator, collaterals as collaterals, products as products, issuers as issuers, scr as scr, creditor as creditor, deposit as deposit, productionPlaces as productionPlaces)

transformations.name: instrument
transformations.expression: CASE WHEN tipo_codigo_cpr = 'F' THEN named_struct('cprTypeCode', instrument_base.cprTypeCode, 'otcRegisterAccountCode', instrument_base.otcRegisterAccountCode, 'otcCustodianAccountCode', instrument_base.otcCustodianAccountCode, 'electronicEmissionIndicator', instrument_base.electronicEmissionIndicator, 'issueDate', instrument_base.issueDate, 'maturityDate', instrument_base.maturityDate, 'issueQuantity', instrument_base.issueQuantity, 'issueValue', instrument_base.issueValue, 'issueFinancialValue', instrument_base.issueFinancialValue, 'profitabilityStartDate', instrument_base.profitabilityStartDate, 'automaticExpirationIndicator', instrument_base.automaticExpirationIndicator, 'collaterals', instrument_base.collaterals, 'products', instrument_base.products, 'issuers', instrument_base.issuers, 'scr', instrument_base.scr, 'creditor', instrument_base.creditor, 'deposit', instrument_base.deposit, 'productionPlaces', instrument_base.productionPlaces, 'paymentMethod', payment_method) ELSE instrument_base END

transformations.name: payload
transformations.expression: struct(id_vert as id_externo, struct(instrument as instrument) as data)

transformations.name: parcelas
transformations.expression: collect_list(struct(concat(numero_contrato, '1') as codigo_controle_parcela_contrato_if, 1 as numero_parcela)) over (partition by numero_contrato)

transformations.name: headers
transformations.expression: array(struct(cast('type' as string) as key, cast('REGISTRO' as binary) as value), struct(cast('kind' as string) as key, cast('ENVIO' as binary) as value))
